Name: Alternate Milk
Author: ABreeman
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64051321]maerumaer2u[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64051321]﻿maerumaer2u[/url]This mod adds a new machine called the masher! It will turn rice, coconut, soybeans and select nuts from PPJA Fruits and Veggies and More Trees into dairy free milks! 

This mod adds 1 new machine and 9 new artisan goods and two drink recipes. The dairy free milks have been changed from artisan goods to actual milk products so that they can be used in recipes that require milk.


[b]This mod requires [/b]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Mod Framework[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598/]Fruits and Veggies[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]More Trees

[/url]A new alternate version has been created that adds hemp milk! The alternate version require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1741]Cannabis Kit[/url]﻿.

[b]Credits: [/b]
Version 1.1 also comes with some great new sprite art and recipe ideas thanks to Fwippy ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64051321]maerumaer2u[/url])! 


[b]Installation:[/b]

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Producer Mod Framework, Fruits and Veggies and More Trees, Cannibis Kit (optional)
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you want.
Step 3. Drag and Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
Delete the masher and the milk items provided by this mod.
Remove the Alternate Milk related folders in the /Mods folder.
